body:
Welcome to RigidAnarchy, a pure vanilla anarchy server. The only rule is no rules. You will never get banned. Hack, grief, and steal. We are not P2W. Your survival is based on your skill.

We run the server on our own hardware and strive to achieve 24/7 uptime!
